verify_resolutions.marker: [VERIFY: final ordinance number not extracted from captured PDF; PDF has blank adoption and publication fields per draft]
verify_resolutions.note: Directly fetched the Granicus-hosted draft ordinance (eagan.granicus.com/MetaViewer.php?view_id=8&clip_id=2657&meta_id=155114, 'Data Center Moratorium Ordinance_Amended_for Council 02-17-2026'). It confirms the ordinance's full operative text -- adding Section 12.09 to Eagan City Code Chapter 12, directed for preparation Feb. 2, 2026, and running through Feb. 17, 2027 -- but the number field itself reads 'ORDINANCE NO. ___ 2ND SERIES', i.e. genuinely blank in this document, matching the prior researcher's finding. Attempted two further routes to a codified/numbered version: library.municode.com/mn/eagan returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to a direct fetch, and the city's own Laserfiche WebLink document repository (eagandocs.cityofeagan.com) returned only a 'cookies must be enabled' portal error page rather than document content. No final ordinance number was recovered in this pass.

evidence.title: Data Center Moratorium Ordinance_Amended_for Council 02-17-2026
evidence.publisher: City of Eagan, Minnesota (Granicus agenda packet)
evidence.supports: Full draft text of the interim ordinance adding Eagan City Code Section 12.09, confirming its scope (data centers/cryptocurrency mining over 20 MW or within 500 feet of residential zoning; expansions of existing/approved projects capped at 9 MW), one-year term ending February 17, 2027, and that the ordinance number itself was left blank in this draft.
evidence.quote: ORDINANCE NO. ___ 2ND SERIES ... Commencing on the effective date of this interim use ordinance and ending on February 17, 2027, or such sooner time as the City Council may determine

decisions.notes: Confirms rather than resolves the existing marker: the blank ordinance-number field is a genuine feature of the city's own captured draft, not a gap in prior research. Checked Municode (403 Forbidden) and the city's Laserfiche WebLink portal (cookie/session wall) for a codified, numbered version; neither was accessible by direct fetch in this pass. Next pass should try the city clerk's office directly or a browser-based tool that can pass Municode's bot check.

evidence.title: City of Rosemount, Minnesota, Ordinance No. 2026-03
